pages.text: $(thing)Requirement$(): all Paths 15.$(br)$(thing)Type$(): active.$(br2)Possesses you into the mob you are looking at, and you control their body. The mob's attacks (fireballs, creeper explosions) and flying mobs work.

You can exit by using the ability again or exiting the form ($(thing)G$()). In the latter case, you take the mob's health (as much as you need, the rest becomes hunger), and the mob dies if their health is too low.$(br2)After this, the form has a cooldown.
